ad_info.reference_style: Clean cream-background transformation timeline ad: 2x2 grid of day-by-day progress panels with a semi-illustrated model, product at bottom left and gold offer plaque at bottom right
ad_info.ad_format: Single Image Ad (2x2 progress timeline grid)

global_identity.color_palette: Warm cream background #FBF3DC; lemon yellow #F2DC4A (product label, accents); metallic gold #C9A441 with lighter gold highlight #E6CF7A (day labels, offer plaque); near-black #111111 (headline and offer text); amber brown #8A4B14 (bottle glass); soft white #FFFFFF for panel fills and highlights.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bright beauty-supplement ad with a soft semi-illustrated realistic rendering of the model (smooth painterly digital illustration with realistic proportions and soft shading), on a light cream canvas with a tidy grid of progress panels.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Light, warm, feminine, optimistic and trustworthy; soft diffused daylight, no harsh shadows.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded-corner rectangular panels with a hairline pale-gold border, generous cream margins, a brushed metallic gold offer plaque with a thin inner border and rounded corners, a delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing behind the product, soft contact shadows under the product.
global_identity.text_typography: Typography of the reference: headline in a geometric sans-serif, extra-bold, all uppercase, solid near-black, centered, two lines, tight leading (Montserrat ExtraBold / Gotham Black style). Panel labels in the same geometric sans, bold, uppercase, metallic gold, small. Offer plaque: first line bold uppercase sans in black; middle line much larger, heavy condensed uppercase sans in black; third line regular-weight uppercase sans with wide letter spacing in black. No outlines, no shadows, no gradients on the text.

creative_objective: Hit the everyday pain of jeans that fit loose at the back and show it solved in 21 days: the same pair of jeans looks better filled in each panel. Close with the product and the user's exact bundle offer, keeping the exact structure of the reference.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two-line black headline at the top. 2) The 2x2 grid of progress panels, read left to right and top to bottom, with the last panel showing the fullest result. 3) The gold offer plaque at bottom right and the product at bottom left.
art_direction.composition_style: Symmetrical, centered, grid-based layout on a flat cream canvas. Three horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: headline band, 2x2 panel grid, bottom band with product (left) and offer plaque (right).
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Even cream margins around the canvas, equal narrow gutters between the four panels, panels of identical size, headline centered with breathing room above the grid, bottom band split roughly 45% product / 55% plaque.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft diffused warm light, flat cream background with a faint paper warmth, gentle soft shading on the model, subtle brushed-metal sheen on the gold plaque, soft contact shadow under the bottle and box.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Flat warm cream canvas. Top band: a centered two-line headline in extra-bold black uppercase sans-serif spanning most of the width. Middle band (largest): a 2x2 grid of four equal rounded-corner panels with hairline pale-gold borders and a slightly lighter cream fill; each panel has a small bold gold uppercase day label in its top-left corner and shows the same woman from a rear three-quarter view, head to mid-thigh, looking back over her shoulder, with her curves visibly fuller from one panel to the next. Bottom band: at bottom left, a tall yellow product carton with the amber dropper bottle standing in front of it, slightly to its right, with a delicate pale-gold botanical sprig drawn behind them; at bottom right, a horizontal brushed-gold rounded plaque with a thin inner border holding three centered lines of black offer text. The brand wordmark that sat under the plaque in the reference is removed and left as plain cream background.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 static ad on a flat warm cream background (#FBF3DC). Recreate exactly the layout of the attached reference ad, re-proportioned to a square while keeping the same top-to-bottom order of bands. TOP BAND: a centered two-line headline in extra-bold uppercase geometric sans-serif, solid near-black, spanning most of the width. MIDDLE BAND (the largest area): a 2x2 grid of four identical rounded-corner rectangular panels with hairline pale-gold borders, equal narrow gutters and even cream margins. Each panel has a small bold metallic-gold uppercase day label in its top-left corner. Every panel shows THE SAME woman in the same pose and framing: a Latina woman around 32 years old with warm tan skin and wavy shoulder-length brown hair with honey highlights worn loose, wearing a white cropped t-shirt and fitted light-blue high-waisted jeans, seen from a rear three-quarter view, framed from head to mid-thigh at waist height, standing upright and looking back over her right shoulder with a pleased, confident smile. Inside each panel, behind her, a softly rendered, pale and low-contrast clothing-store fitting room with a beige curtain and the edge of a mirror, so the panels stay light and airy. From the first panel to the fourth, her hips and glutes look gradually fuller and rounder in a natural, believable, healthy progression: in the first panel the same jeans look slightly loose and flat at the back; in the fourth panel the same jeans are nicely filled with clearly fuller curves. Her face, hair, outfit, pose and the fitting room stay identical in all four. Rendering style of the woman and room: the same soft semi-illustrated realistic look as the reference, a smooth painterly digital illustration with realistic proportions and gentle shading; tasteful, fully clothed, everyday fashion tone. BOTTOM BAND, LEFT: the product, using the attached product image as the only source of truth: a 60 ml amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders, a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper, with a wraparound label that fades from bright lemon yellow at the top to white at the bottom, showing the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small line of text and five small circular ingredient badges. Do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. Behind the bottle and slightly to its left stands its tall rectangular lemon-yellow carton, slightly taller than the bottle, with the lowercase wordmark 'amua' at the top and 'VITALDROPS' in white uppercase running vertically, as in the reference. A delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing sits behind and to the right of the product; soft contact shadow underneath. Do not include the round yellow '60 ml' sticker from the product photo. BOTTOM BAND, RIGHT: a horizontal brushed metallic gold plaque with rounded corners and a thin inner border, holding three centered lines of black text: a bold uppercase first line, a much larger heavy condensed uppercase middle line, and a lighter wide-spaced uppercase third line. The area under the plaque is plain cream background with no logo and no text. No other elements.
